checks.notes: Absence of a token is not called divergence; this check compares only definitions of the canonical shared names.
checks.rule: Every definition of a shared SAAGAR design token must equal its canonical normalized value.
checks.title: Shared design-token divergence

checks.rule: Enumerate every discovered shell/module surface across the frozen mobile/desktop viewports and English, Marathi and Hindi.
checks.title: Surface, viewport and language matrix

checks.notes: Evidence stores only source location, kind and a one-way text fingerprint; rendered/dynamic completeness is decided by A6-05.
checks.rule: Static text on controls, control labels, accessibility attributes, literal notification calls and first-party shared JavaScript DOM-label sinks must be covered by the shared localization dictionary unless it is business data, a proper name or an approved technical label.
checks.title: Static localization bypass

checks.notes: Computed target and contrast outcomes were supplied by the identity-bound external renderer; physical-device acceptance remains separate.
checks.rule: Rendered interactive targets must be at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels; normal text contrast must be at least 4.5:1 and large text at least 3:1.
checks.title: Rendered target size and contrast

checks.notes: Rendered evidence establishes browser matrix coverage only; it does not establish physical-device or fluent-language acceptance.
checks.rule: Exactly 72 unique mandatory surface, viewport and language cells must carry rendered evidence hashes bound to the exact product SHA, product fingerprint, tooling SHA, browser identity and matrix hash.
checks.title: Identity-bound rendered matrix evidence

title: UI, responsive behavior, i18n and accessibility
